card.name: Linking words in all-caps warnings
card.fires_on: Small linking or auxiliary words (been, be, when, and) and word endings inside ALL-CAPS boxed warning text. It fires where monitoring, treatment or reaction wording is about to continue.

modes.label: Auxiliary words before monitoring
modes.description: Words like BE or BEEN in capitalized warnings that lead into monitoring or duration phrases.
modes.example: NEUTROPHIL COUNTS SHOULD<< BE>> MONITORED DURING CIDOFO

modes.label: Conjunctions after reactions
modes.description: WHEN or AND in capitalized warning sentences linking a reaction to a treatment or to a patient group.
modes.example: WHO HAVE EXPERIENCED SEVERE REACTIONS<< WHEN>> TREATED WITH CEPHALOSPOR

modes.label: Inside capitalized drug terms
modes.description: Word endings in capitalized drug or electrolyte names.
modes.example: MINERAL AND ELECTROLY<<TE>> SUPPLEMENTATION MAY BE REQUIRED.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly unrelated Chinese words, so there is no clear effect on English output.
card.plain: It lights up on small connecting words in capitalized boxed warnings, especially before monitoring or treatment wording.
